skills.name: Athletics
skills.use: Climb, jump, swim, grapple, shove, break

skills.name: Intimidation
skills.use: Scare, coerce, dominate a room

skills.name: Melee
skills.use: Attack with clubs, spears and fists

skills.name: Acrobatics
skills.use: Balance, tumble, vault, parkour

skills.name: Finesse
skills.use: Pick pockets, palm objects, delicate manual work

skills.name: Marksmanship
skills.use: Attack with bows and firearms

skills.name: Stealth
skills.use: Hide, sneak, move unseen

skills.name: Endurance
skills.use: Push through pain, hazards, exhaustion

skills.name: Heavy Weapons
skills.use: Attack with energy and heavy weapons

skills.name: Mechanics
skills.use: Repair, fabricate, judge structural integrity

skills.name: Hacking
skills.use: System override, security cracking, attacks with support gear

skills.name: Investigation
skills.use: Research, deduce, dig up corporate intel

skills.name: Salvage
skills.use: Scavenge tech, strip parts, identify blueprints

skills.name: Insight
skills.use: Read people, bots and animals; spot lies

skills.name: Medicine
skills.use: Biometrics, first aid, stabilizing the Flatlined

skills.name: Perception
skills.use: Notice, search, track, spot the hidden

skills.name: Survival
skills.use: Navigate, endure environments, find routes

skills.name: Deception
skills.use: Lie, disguise, forge, misdirect

skills.name: Performance
skills.use: Crowd appeal, stunts, playing to the cameras

skills.name: Persuasion
skills.use: Negotiate, charm, cut a deal with a sponsor

origins.label: INMATE BLOCK
origins.traitText: +5 maximum Hardware Integrity, and advantage on saves against being Stunned or Pinned.
origins.story: Paying off a sentence one broadcast at a time. The program bought your file from the prison system.

origins.label: SLUM DISTRIKT VOLUNTEER
origins.traitText: +15% starting Data Fragments (138), +8 starting Engagement and +180 viewers.
origins.story: You signed the waiver yourself: for fragments, for a sponsor, for a way out of a district the Council barely knows exists.

origins.label: OFF-GRID GLITCHER
origins.traitText: Your support slot is rolled (1-3 Multi-Tool, 4-6 Field Radio). Hostile AI prioritizes you. +5 Engagement and +90 viewers.
origins.story: You lived where the network breaks down, and something in your data never patched cleanly.

origins.label: OFF-WORLDER
origins.traitText: Use any background (a Glitcher background keeps its own support item, no roll). +1 skill rank at creation. Once per deployment, one Federation identity system finds nothing on you. 120 fragments, no Engagement bonus.
origins.story: Pulled from a planet outside the Federation: conscripted, or you took a deal without knowing what it was. You play to get home, or to earn citizenship.

backgrounds.name: The Enforcer
backgrounds.flavor: Cartel muscle and pit fighters who survived by crushing competition.
notes: Frontline bruiser package tuned for close pressure and durability.

backgrounds.name: The Infiltrator
backgrounds.flavor: Corporate thieves and ghost agents specialized in bypassing high-security sectors.
notes: Skirmish and scouting profile with tactical intel support.

backgrounds.name: The Cyber-Syndicate Tech
backgrounds.flavor: Digital vault raiders convicted for trying to drain megacorp credit reserves.
notes: Control-and-intrusion package focused on support infrastructure.

backgrounds.name: The Riot-Breaker
backgrounds.flavor: A corrupt max-security guard or rebel riot leader forged in prison block warfare.
notes: Durable breach profile with defensive mitigation baseline.

backgrounds.name: The Solitary Drifter
backgrounds.flavor: Years in isolation tuned your senses to server-hum and environmental signal drift.
notes: Survival package optimized for attrition and hazard routes.

backgrounds.name: The Scrap-Scavver
backgrounds.flavor: Yard engineers who survive by extracting chips, copper, and code from urban wreckage.
notes: Economy-efficient build with fabrication and salvage pressure.

backgrounds.name: The Media Star
backgrounds.flavor: Arena influencers and stunt icons who play for viewers as much as victory.
notes: Showmanship package focused on range control and comm advantage.

backgrounds.name: The Corporate Dropout
backgrounds.flavor: Former analysts and accountants who entered the arena to escape debt and silence.
notes: Intel analyst package with tactical offense and utility throughput.

backgrounds.name: The Street Medic
backgrounds.flavor: Back-alley cyber-docs who volunteered to repay stolen supply chains.
notes: Support-healer baseline with improved sustain and protection.

backgrounds.name: The Neon Runner
backgrounds.flavor: Rooftop data couriers hardened by high-speed traversal through hostile city grids.
notes: High-mobility scout package for objective routing and kiting.

backgrounds.name: The Severed Synth
backgrounds.flavor: Escaped android labor units hiding in arena traffic after severing corporate control.
notes: Glitcher bruiser profile with defensive core and anomaly aggro pressure.

backgrounds.name: The Glitched Ghost
backgrounds.flavor: Server crash fragments left your avatar unstable, trailing artifacts and phantom echoes.
notes: Evasive anomaly package with recon and displacement style play.

backgrounds.name: The Code Hunter
backgrounds.flavor: Rogue bounty operatives who track glitched entities in unmonitored sectors.
notes: Bounty-tracker package for target acquisition and ranged pressure.

backgrounds.name: The System-Drift Nomad
backgrounds.flavor: Dead-zone wanderers adapted to regions where AI resource allocation collapses.
notes: Wasteland skirmisher package for close-range survival engagements.

backgrounds.name: The Memory Broker
backgrounds.flavor: Smugglers of deleted memory packets and unpatched code sold to the highest bidder.
notes: Social-controller package balancing comm leverage and ranged threat.

rules.feature: High durability: immune to item-loss effects.

gear.name: Tactical Carbine
gear.functionality: Versatile platform that accepts sights and suppressors.

gear.name: Hard-Light Lance
gear.functionality: Energy-based strikes that ignore non-energy cover.

rules.feature: Advantage on saves against environmental hazards.
Ranged kinetic attacks from beyond 10 m have disadvantage.

gear.name: Multi-Tool
gear.functionality: Essential for basic repairs and scavenging.

rules.feature: +1 die on Mechanics and Salvage checks; field repairs and scavenging.
Callout (1 AP): an ally who can hear you gets +1 die on their next attack this round.
Jam (2 AP): until your next turn, machines and network entities within 10 m save (18) or lose 1 AP, and nobody in range can call reinforcements.

blueprints.name: Weighted/Reinforced Frame
blueprints.rules: Durability: weapon deals +1 damage and can't be broken or disarmed.

blueprints.name: Precision Sight
blueprints.effect: Adds +1 accuracy and range to Tactical offensive items.
blueprints.rules: +1 die on attacks with this weapon; range x1.5.

blueprints.name: Essence-Capacitor
blueprints.effect: Allows weapons to store and release high-energy bursts.
blueprints.rules: Charge (1 AP): your next hit with this weapon releases +2d6 energy damage.

blueprints.name: Padding/Reinforcement
blueprints.effect: Increases mitigation for hide or textile armor.
blueprints.rules: Reduce physical damage from each hit by 1.

blueprints.name: Kinetic Plating
blueprints.effect: Adds resistance to bullet and impact damage.
blueprints.rules: Reduce kinetic, piercing and blunt damage from each hit by 2.

blueprints.name: Phase-Shifter
blueprints.effect: Grants a chance to negate incoming energy damage entirely.
blueprints.rules: When an energy attack hits you, roll 1d6: on 5-6 it is negated entirely.

blueprints.name: Extended Battery/Capacity
blueprints.effect: Increases usage duration of support items.
blueprints.rules: Support effects with a duration last 1 round longer; once-per-encounter features gain one extra use.

blueprints.name: Signal Booster
blueprints.rules: Double comms and scanning range; +1 die on Perception checks made through sensors.

blueprints.name: Hacking Suite
blueprints.effect: Allows remote override of hostile turrets or terminals.
blueprints.rules: Override (2 AP): DATA + Hacking against a turret, terminal or drone's Defense; on a success you control it until the end of your next turn.

blueprints.name: Ghostline Scope
blueprints.effect: Named optic package that grants precision through dense obscurants.
blueprints.rules: +1 die on attacks with this weapon; ignore smoke, fog and other obscurants.

blueprints.name: Bulwark Sigil
blueprints.effect: Named ward lattice that redirects a burst of incoming force.
blueprints.rules: Once per encounter, reaction (1 AP): redirect one hit's damage to an enemy within 2 m.

blueprints.name: Crownbreaker Daemon Key
blueprints.effect: Legendary intrusion key enabling one controlled hostile subsystem breach.
blueprints.rules: Once per session: seize one hostile subsystem (a boss ability, a Security-Node network, a turret grid) for the rest of the scene.

blueprints.name: Neon Tracer
blueprints.effect: Enhances projectile visibility for stylized shot tracking.
blueprints.streamTrait: +10% engagement gain when offensive pressure is maintained.
blueprints.rules: +1 die on attacks against a target you attacked last turn.

blueprints.name: Kill-Feed Display
blueprints.effect: Projects real-time combat telemetry overlays into the public feed.
blueprints.rules: Allies get +1 to attack totals against targets you hit this round.

blueprints.name: Holographic Cloak
blueprints.effect: Generates visual decoys and distortion around the operator silhouette.
blueprints.streamTrait: +20% engagement spike after a close-call evade.
blueprints.rules: Reaction (1 AP): an attack against you has disadvantage.

blueprints.name: Signature Finisher
blueprints.effect: Unlocks a branded execution sequence with custom camera priority.
blueprints.streamTrait: Massive viewer spike when closing an encounter on-camera.
blueprints.rules: Branded execution: dropping an enemy to 0 with this weapon is a guaranteed highlight (+1 Engagement).

nodes.name: Iron Frame
nodes.description: Reinforce biological chassis for increased trauma resistance.

subSkills.name: Plated Dermis
subSkills.description: Sub-dermal alloy weave reduces all incoming physical damage by 1.

subSkills.name: Stress Hardening
subSkills.description: Each hit you take gives you +1 damage resistance against later hits until the end of the round.

nodes.name: Kinetic Driver
nodes.description: Hydraulic limb enhancement boosts melee output.

subSkills.name: Power Strike
subSkills.description: Spend 1 extra AP on a melee attack to double its base damage die.

subSkills.name: Ground Pound
subSkills.description: Slam attack forces all adjacent targets to pass a HARDWARE check or fall prone.

nodes.name: Overclock Shell
nodes.description: Short-burst physical overclock at cost of heat buildup.

subSkills.name: Burst Mode
subSkills.description: Gain +2 AP this turn. Next turn start with -1 AP due to thermal cooldown.

subSkills.name: Heat Vent
subSkills.description: Release stored heat as a cone of scorching exhaust, dealing 1d4 to adjacent enemies.

nodes.name: Bulwark Protocol
nodes.description: Active defensive stance that absorbs frontal damage.

subSkills.name: Shield Wall
subSkills.description: Spend 1 AP to halve all incoming damage from a single frontal source this round.

subSkills.name: Absorb and Counter
subSkills.description: When damage is halved by Shield Wall, immediately deal 1d6 back to the attacker.

nodes.name: Titan Chassis
nodes.description: Maximum Hardware Integrity cap increase.

subSkills.name: Reinforced Plating
subSkills.description: Permanently increase maximum Hardware Integrity by 5.

subSkills.name: Redundant Systems
subSkills.description: Neural Shock threshold drops to 35% — you survive longer before throttling.

nodes.name: Seismic Slam
nodes.description: Area-of-effect ground strike disrupts enemy positioning.

subSkills.name: Shockwave
subSkills.description: Ground slam radiates 2m; enemies in range make a POWER save or lose 1 AP next turn.

subSkills.name: Tremor Pulse
subSkills.description: Shockwave also disables vehicle and drone movement for 1 round in the radius.

nodes.name: Neural Anchor
nodes.description: Resist Neural Shock triggers at extreme damage thresholds.

subSkills.name: Shock Suppressor
subSkills.description: Once per encounter, ignore a Neural Shock trigger entirely.

subSkills.name: Pain Nullifier
subSkills.description: While in Neural Shock, the -1 AP penalty is negated for 2 rounds.

nodes.name: War Engine
nodes.description: Sustained combat mode — reduced AP cost for physical actions.

subSkills.note: War Engine switches on for the rest of the encounter once you make a melee attack. Attacks already cost 1 AP, so Combat Flow cuts melee abilities that cost 2+ AP (Ground Pound, Shockwave) and makes Power Strike’s extra AP free.
subSkills.name: Combat Flow
subSkills.description: All melee attacks cost 1 less AP (minimum 1) while War Engine is active.

subSkills.name: Momentum
subSkills.description: Each consecutive melee hit in a turn grants +1 damage on the next.

nodes.name: Fortress Mode
nodes.description: Locks movement in exchange for massive defense.

subSkills.use: Passive (if you haven’t moved this turn)
subSkills.name: Static Defense
subSkills.description: While stationary, reduce all incoming damage by 3.

subSkills.name: Turret Stance
subSkills.description: Gain an extra reaction each round, usable only for defensive counters.

nodes.name: Apex Predator
nodes.description: Execute weakened targets for immediate AP refund.

subSkills.name: Execution
subSkills.description: A finishing blow on a target at or below 25% of its Integrity (or Hardware) refunds 2 AP immediately.

subSkills.note: An execution is a finishing blow that triggers Execution.
subSkills.name: Trophy Kill
subSkills.description: Each execution this encounter grants +1 to all POWER checks until end of session.

nodes.name: Stealth Protocol
nodes.description: Reduce electronic and optical detection signature.

subSkills.name: Optical Cloak
subSkills.description: Bend light around your chassis for 1 round; enemies must pass a PING check to target you.

subSkills.name: Ping Mask
subSkills.description: Suppress all active radio and sonar pings emanating from your gear for 2 rounds.

nodes.name: Neural Reflex
nodes.description: Enhanced reaction time provides bonus dodge window.

subSkills.name: Reflex Dodge
subSkills.description: Once per round, as a reaction costing 1 AP, halve the damage of an incoming ranged attack.

subSkills.name: Counter-Frame
subSkills.description: After a successful dodge, your next melee attack gains +2 dice.

nodes.name: Ghost Walk
nodes.description: Silent movement system nullifies footstep detection.

subSkills.name: Featherfall
subSkills.description: Landing from any height produces zero acoustic signature.

subSkills.name: No Signature
subSkills.description: Movement through sensor zones does not trigger proximity alerts.

nodes.name: Firewall Veil
nodes.description: Instant reactive Overshield on trigger for 1 AP.

subSkills.name: Emergency Veil
subSkills.description: Spend 1 AP as a reaction when hit to instantly restore 4 Overshield points.

subSkills.name: Cascade Block
subSkills.description: If the veil absorbs the full attack, the next incoming hit this round also costs +1 AP for the attacker.

nodes.name: Phase Shift
nodes.description: Briefly displace spatial signature — dodge one attack entirely.

subSkills.name: Blink
subSkills.description: Teleport up to 3m as a reaction; the triggering attack misses automatically.

subSkills.use: +1 AP after Blink: untargetable until your next turn
subSkills.note: Spend 1 more AP right after Blink: you stay untargetable until your next turn starts.
subSkills.name: Void Step
subSkills.description: After Blinking, remain untargetable for 1 additional AP worth of time.

nodes.name: Signal Jammer
nodes.description: Disrupt enemy communications for one round.

subSkills.name: Static Burst
subSkills.description: All enemy coordination bonuses are nullified for 1 round in a 10m radius.

subSkills.name: Comms Blackout
subSkills.description: Enemies cannot call for reinforcements or share targeting data this round.

nodes.name: Shadow Network
nodes.description: Establish covert relay for persistent intel feed.

subSkills.name: Dark Web Tap
subSkills.description: Passively intercept all encrypted enemy transmissions within 50m.

subSkills.name: Persistent Ghost
subSkills.description: Your stealth state no longer breaks when you attack with ranged weapons.

nodes.name: System Ghost
nodes.description: Remove character from all electronic tracking entirely.

subSkills.name: Off-Grid
subSkills.description: Your biometric data disappears from all corporate databases for the session.

subSkills.name: Null Identity
subSkills.description: Any facial or gait recognition systems return a null result when scanning you.

nodes.name: Reflex Engine
nodes.description: Trigger two reactions in a single round.

subSkills.name: Double Dodge
subSkills.description: Use Reflex Dodge twice per round instead of once.

subSkills.name: Reactive Firewall
subSkills.description: Trigger Emergency Veil and Reflex Dodge simultaneously for 2 AP.

nodes.name: Apex Phantom
nodes.description: Eliminate target without triggering any alert state.

subSkills.note: Heat is the scene’s alert level (Calm, Alert, Lockdown); the GM raises it when security notices you.
subSkills.name: Clean Kill
subSkills.description: Executing a target from stealth generates zero heat on the threat board.

subSkills.name: No Trace
subSkills.description: Bodies eliminated via Clean Kill are automatically concealed from enemy patrols.

nodes.name: Data Tap
nodes.description: Extract live intel from enemy networks during combat.

subSkills.name: Live Feed
subSkills.description: Continuously stream enemy positions to your HUD — no action required.

subSkills.name: Memory Rip
subSkills.description: Download a defeated enemy's last 60 seconds of sensory memory for intel.

nodes.name: Crowd Control
nodes.description: Broadcast disruptive signals to stagger multiple enemies.

subSkills.name: EMP Pulse
subSkills.description: Spend 2 AP to disable all electronic devices in a 5m radius for 1 round.

subSkills.name: Daze Field
subSkills.description: Enemies affected by EMP Pulse lose 1 AP on their next turn.

nodes.name: Operator Clout
nodes.description: Leverage corporate identity for resource access mid-field.

subSkills.name: Access Override
subSkills.description: Spend 1 AP to unlock any standard corporate door or terminal without a key.

subSkills.name: Corporate Bypass
subSkills.description: Invoke a false corp identity to pause a hostile NPC for 1 round.

nodes.name: Tactical Upload
nodes.description: Share targeting data with allies to boost hit accuracy.

subSkills.note: Live Feed covers every enemy within 50 m that you or an ally can see.
subSkills.name: Shared Targeting
subSkills.description: Each round, designate one enemy you have Live Feed on: all allies gain +2 on attack rolls against it until your next turn.

subSkills.name: Marked Threat
subSkills.description: Designate one enemy as Priority Target; all damage against them is increased by 1 die.

nodes.name: Black Market Cache
nodes.description: Access hidden gear drops from pre-planted stashes.

subSkills.note: A cache holds one of: 1d6+2 Hardware repair, a full Overshield, or one extra use of a once-per-encounter feature.
subSkills.name: Cache Access
subSkills.description: Once per session, retrieve a concealed supply cache containing consumables or ammo.

subSkills.name: Emergency Supply
subSkills.description: Cache Access can be triggered as a reaction when HW Integrity drops below 30%.

nodes.name: Media Blackout
nodes.description: Suppress live broadcast feeds — neutralize spectator scoring.

subSkills.note: Arena scoring is Engagement: during the jam, nobody gains or loses Engagement.
subSkills.name: Broadcast Jam
subSkills.description: Disable arena scoring systems for 2 rounds — no points accrue for either side.

subSkills.note: Undo all Engagement changes from the jammed rounds.
subSkills.name: Score Wipe
subSkills.description: After Broadcast Jam ends, erase the point record of the jammed rounds entirely.

nodes.name: Network Dominator
nodes.description: Seize control of local network infrastructure.

subSkills.name: Node Capture
subSkills.description: Take control of an enemy network node; redirect its effects to benefit your team.

subSkills.name: Admin Override
subSkills.description: Spend 3 AP to assume root access over any facility system in range.

nodes.name: Crowd Favorite
nodes.description: Live crowd engagement restores AP via spectator votes.

subSkills.note: The GM calls an audience vote at a highlight; operators with 10+ flair that round win it.
subSkills.name: Fan Boost
subSkills.description: When the audience votes for you, gain 1 AP immediately (GM adjudicates).

subSkills.note: Temporary attribute boosts can push an attribute above 5.
subSkills.name: Viral Moment
subSkills.description: Performing a spectacular action in view of cameras grants +2 CLOUT for the session.

nodes.name: Corps Insider
nodes.description: Reveal hidden corporate objectives and faction motives.

subSkills.name: Intel Leak
subSkills.description: Expose one hidden corporate objective at the start of a scene.

subSkills.name: Agenda Exposed
subSkills.description: Once exposed, allies gain advantage on all rolls related to that objective.

nodes.name: Apex Operator
nodes.description: Deploy full-spectrum tactical superiority for one encounter.

subSkills.name: Command Mode
subSkills.description: For 3 rounds, all allies act on your initiative and may spend your AP.

subSkills.name: Total Control
subSkills.description: While Command Mode is active, enemy reactions are reduced by 1 per round.

nodes.name: Phantom Strike
nodes.description: Silent devastating melee attack that leaves no evidence.

subSkills.name: Unseen Blow
subSkills.description: Melee attack from stealth deals +2 damage dice and does not break concealment.

subSkills.name: Vanish After
subSkills.description: Immediately re-enter stealth after Unseen Blow at no AP cost.

nodes.prerequisite: Needs a node in both BRUTE and GHOST.

nodes.name: Adaptive Armor
nodes.description: Armor morphs to match incoming damage type automatically.

subSkills.name: Thermal Weave
subSkills.description: On the first heat or energy hit each round, reduce damage by 3.

subSkills.name: Kinetic Absorb
subSkills.description: On the first physical hit each round, reduce damage by 2 and store 1 AP.

nodes.prerequisite: Needs a node in both BRUTE and GHOST.

nodes.name: Ambush Engine
nodes.description: First strike from stealth deals double Hardware Integrity damage.

subSkills.name: Death Blow
subSkills.description: Opening strike from full stealth bypasses Overshield and hits HW directly.

subSkills.name: Opener
subSkills.description: Death Blow also staggers the target, removing 1 AP from their next turn.

nodes.prerequisite: Needs a tier-2 BRUTE ∩ GHOST node.

nodes.name: Combat Broadcast
nodes.description: Deal damage and stream it live for live-audience AP bonuses.

subSkills.note: Cameras are active unless a Media Blackout or a dark scene is in effect.
subSkills.name: Hype Kill
subSkills.description: Eliminating an enemy while cameras are active restores 1 AP.

subSkills.name: Live Execution
subSkills.description: Performing an execution with Hype Kill active grants +1 CLOUT and 2 AP.

nodes.prerequisite: Needs a node in both BRUTE and SPECIALIST.

nodes.name: Salvage Rig
nodes.description: Rip components from defeated enemies for field repairs.

subSkills.use: Free · after you defeat an enemy
subSkills.name: Strip Salvage
subSkills.description: After defeating an enemy, recover parts worth 1d6 Hardware Integrity (self).

subSkills.name: Field Weld
subSkills.description: Spend 2 AP to immediately apply salvaged parts, restoring 1d6+2 HW Integrity.

nodes.prerequisite: Needs a node in both BRUTE and SPECIALIST.

nodes.name: Warboss Authority
nodes.description: Impose fear through sheer presence — enemies lose 1 AP.

subSkills.name: Intimidate
subSkills.description: Spend 1 AP to force one enemy to pass a CLOUT save or lose 1 AP this turn.

subSkills.name: Dread Aura
subSkills.description: All enemies within 5m of you begin their turn with a -1 morale penalty on saves.

nodes.prerequisite: Needs a tier-2 BRUTE ∩ SPECIALIST node.

nodes.name: Ghost Protocol
nodes.description: Wipe all electronic evidence of actions taken this round.

subSkills.note: Threat-level is the scene’s heat (see G10).
subSkills.name: Log Wipe
subSkills.description: At end of round, purge all enemy sensor logs of your activity this turn.

subSkills.name: Clean Slate
subSkills.description: Log Wipe also removes any threat-level increases you triggered this round.

nodes.prerequisite: Needs a node in both GHOST and SPECIALIST.

nodes.name: Deep Cover
nodes.description: Maintain a false corporate identity for extended missions.

subSkills.name: False ID
subSkills.description: Generate a convincing corporate credential that passes automated verification.

subSkills.note: NPC attitudes run Hostile, Neutral, Friendly; Neutral NPCs talk before they shoot.
subSkills.name: Legend Build
subSkills.description: Your false identity accrues a positive reputation — NPCs start as Neutral rather than Hostile.

nodes.prerequisite: Needs a node in both GHOST and SPECIALIST.

nodes.name: Phantom Operator
nodes.description: Combine total electronic invisibility with network dominance.

subSkills.name: Null Node
subSkills.description: Your presence on any network appears as background noise — undetectable.

subSkills.name: Ghost Admin
subSkills.description: Take administrative control of any network node without triggering security alerts.

nodes.prerequisite: Needs a tier-2 GHOST ∩ SPECIALIST node.

bestiary.name: Glitch-Scrapper
bestiary.description: Human form with jagged, rusted metal plates bolted to limbs; they twitch uncontrollably.

abilities.name: Swarm
abilities.text: Gets +1 die on attacks for each other Glitch-Scrapper adjacent to its target (max +2).

abilities.name: Twitch
abilities.text: Its first attack each encounter has disadvantage: it can’t stop shaking.

bestiary.tactics: Surround the nearest operator; never retreat.

bestiary.name: Net-Junkie
bestiary.description: Frayed cables; mismatched, buzzing weapons that spark with excess current.

abilities.name: Sparking Spray
abilities.text: Ranged attack, 20 m. On a hit with 5+ flair, the target makes a DATA save (13) or is Glitched.

bestiary.tactics: Hang back behind cover and spray whoever is fighting the Scrappers.

bestiary.name: Debt-Dodger
bestiary.description: Lean, nervous figures wearing lightweight, minimalist gear for high-speed evasion.

abilities.name: Skip Town
abilities.text: After it attacks, it may Move 6 m for free.

abilities.name: Hard to Pin Down
abilities.text: Ranged attacks against it have disadvantage on any round it has moved.

bestiary.tactics: Hit, run, repeat. Goes after isolated operators.

bestiary.name: Stream-Whore
bestiary.description: Neon-reflective fabrics and strobing LEDs; designed for high-definition feeds.

abilities.name: Strobe Feed
abilities.text: 1 AP. Until its next turn, allies within 10 m get +1 die on attacks.

abilities.name: Spotlight
abilities.text: 1 AP, 20 m. One operator is Marked until the end of its next turn.

bestiary.tactics: Stay behind the line; Spotlight whoever is hurting the most.

bestiary.name: Rig-Breaker
bestiary.description: Hulking silhouette in heavy industrial plating; moves with a heavy, hydraulic thud.

abilities.name: Hydraulic Slam
abilities.text: 2 AP. Melee attack; on a hit the target also makes a POWER save (15) or is knocked Prone.

abilities.name: Heavy Plate
abilities.text: Reduce physical damage from each hit by 1.

bestiary.tactics: Walk into the middle and start slamming.

bestiary.name: Code-Leech
bestiary.description: Pale-skinned with interface ports on their neck; they avoid eye contact while tracking data.

abilities.name: Siphon
abilities.text: 1 AP, 10 m, no attack roll. The target loses 1d4 Overshield and the Leech regains that much Integrity.

abilities.name: Plant Leak
abilities.text: 2 AP. Seed a 2 m patch of pixel-rot (DATA save 11 or Glitched) on its square.

bestiary.tactics: Never melee. Siphons from range, retreats, leaves rot behind.

bestiary.name: The Desperate
bestiary.description: Shivering, gaunt figures with no armor; they fight with jagged glass or metal shanks.

abilities.name: Nothing to Lose
abilities.text: When reduced to 0 Integrity, it makes one last attack immediately, for free.

bestiary.tactics: Throw them at the operators in waves.

bestiary.name: The Martyr
bestiary.description: Heavily bandaged; their chest is rigged with a volatile, glowing core that pulses violently.

abilities.name: Core Breach
abilities.text: When defeated, or as a 2 AP action, it explodes: 2d6 damage to everything within 3 m (PING save 13 for half). The Martyr is destroyed.

abilities.name: Pulse Warning
abilities.text: Its core glows; an operator can spot an imminent breach with Perception (15).

bestiary.tactics: Run straight at the biggest group of operators.

bestiary.name: The Traitor
bestiary.description: Looks like a standard player, but eyes flicker with an unsettling, synthetic red strobe.

abilities.name: Familiar Face
abilities.text: It looks like a contestant. Until an operator sees through it (SYSTEM + Insight, 15, 1 AP), that operator can’t target it.

abilities.name: Copycat
abilities.text: It uses the attack and damage of one operator it can see (choose each turn).

bestiary.tactics: Walk up "friendly", then knife the healer.

bestiary.name: Corp Shill
bestiary.description: Pristine, high-end armor branded with sponsor logos; unnerving, polished confidence.

abilities.name: Sponsored Armor
abilities.text: The first hit against it each round deals 2 less damage.

abilities.name: Brand Protection
abilities.text: An operator who damages it on camera loses 1 Engagement; the sponsor is not amused.

abilities.name: Endorsed Strike
abilities.text: 2 AP. Attack with +2 dice; on a hit the target is Staggered.

bestiary.tactics: Fight the highest-Engagement operator. It wants the camera.

bestiary.name: Auditor
bestiary.description: Humanoids in tailored suits; flat, HD screen faces display rotating currency symbols.

abilities.name: Assess
abilities.text: 1 AP, 20 m. The target is Marked until the end of the encounter.

abilities.name: Line Item
abilities.text: Each time a Marked operator is hit, they lose 2 Data Fragments.

bestiary.tactics: Stays at the edge, Assessing. Flees at the first hit.

bestiary.name: Censor
bestiary.description: Small, polished chrome spheres; they track targets with an aggressive, laser-red eye.

abilities.name: Squelch Pulse
abilities.text: 2 AP. Operators within 5 m make a SYSTEM save (13) or are Staggered, and can’t use Callout or speak on comms until their next turn.

bestiary.tactics: Float into the middle and pulse every round.

bestiary.name: Liquidator
bestiary.description: Faceless figures in long, dark trench coats made of dense, tangled data-cables.

abilities.name: Neural-Sever
abilities.text: Its hits deal +2 damage to Hardware Integrity. If the target is in Neural Shock, it must also make a HARDWARE save (13) or be Stunned.

bestiary.tactics: Hunts operators who are already hurt.

bestiary.name: Blight-Drone
bestiary.description: Spherical tanks on magnetic cushions; they leave a trail of oily, flickering pixel-rot.

abilities.name: Pixel-Rot Trail
abilities.text: Every space it leaves becomes pixel-rot for the rest of the encounter: an operator entering it makes a DATA save (13) or is Glitched.

bestiary.tactics: Circle the arena, spreading rot.

bestiary.name: Wall-Stalker
bestiary.description: Translucent human figures that lag in and out of reality.

abilities.name: Lag Blink
abilities.text: 1 AP. Teleport up to 10 m; its next attack this turn has advantage.

abilities.name: Out of Sync
abilities.text: Opportunity-style reactions (Counter) against it have disadvantage.

bestiary.tactics: Blink behind the backline, strike, blink away.

bestiary.name: Firewall-Brute
bestiary.description: Towering, static-filled barriers of light that pulse with forbidden data.

abilities.name: Wall of Light
abilities.text: Blocks a 4 m line; nothing passes through it. Operators that start a turn adjacent take 1d4.

abilities.name: Forbidden Data
abilities.text: Its melee hits make the target Fried (HARDWARE save 13).

bestiary.tactics: Placed to split the squad or block the exit. Destroy it to pass.

bestiary.name: Ad-Revenue-Bot
bestiary.description: Covered in digital screens cycling through aggressive commercial advertisements.

abilities.name: Ad Break Aura
abilities.text: Allies within 5 m get +1 to attack totals and damage. Operators within 5 m have disadvantage on Stealth.

bestiary.tactics: Stay behind the heaviest ally and keep the aura up.

bestiary.name: System-Janitor
bestiary.description: Clunky machines with sweeping appendages designed to absorb corrupted data.

abilities.name: Sweep
abilities.text: 1 AP. One ally within 3 m regains 1d6+2 Integrity.

abilities.name: Absorb Corruption
abilities.text: 1 AP. Remove Glitched or Fried from one ally within 3 m.

bestiary.tactics: Keep the Tank or Elite alive. Kill it first.

bestiary.name: Mainframe-Guardian (Anti-Cheat)
bestiary.description: 8-foot-tall monolith of shifting steel; hovers silently without traditional limbs.

abilities.name: Anti-Cheat
abilities.text: It can target Stealthed operators within 10 m. Any operator who uses an Apex or sponsor-grade blueprint effect within 10 m is Marked.

abilities.name: Ban Hammer
abilities.text: 2 AP. Melee attack; on a hit the target is Pinned (POWER save 15 resists).

bestiary.tactics: Stand in front of the objective and punish anything flashy.

bestiary.name: Rent-Enforcer (Collector)
bestiary.description: Ornate gold armor; carries a heavy, industrial-sized ledger as a blunt weapon.

abilities.name: Ledger Slam
abilities.text: On a hit, the target also loses 5 Data Fragments.

abilities.name: Past Due
abilities.text: +1 die on attacks against an operator with fewer than 50 fragments.

bestiary.tactics: Goes for the poorest operator, loudly.

bestiary.name: Blight-Drone (Pusher)
bestiary.description: Wide-bodied drone with rotating magnetic plates that repel physical objects.

abilities.name: Repulse
abilities.text: 1 AP. Every operator within 5 m is pushed 4 m away (POWER save 13 resists).

abilities.name: Magnetic Field
abilities.text: Ranged kinetic attacks against it have disadvantage.

bestiary.tactics: Shove operators off ledges and into hazards.

bestiary.name: Blight-Drone (Screamer)
bestiary.description: Multi-pronged sphere that vibrates; emits a static-filled, high-pitched shriek.

abilities.name: Shriek
abilities.text: 2 AP. Operators within 10 m make a SYSTEM save (13) or are Lagged.

bestiary.tactics: Shriek on round one, then every other round.

bestiary.name: Wall-Stalker (Variant)
bestiary.description: Shimmering, translucent figure that only solidifies for a split second before striking.

abilities.name: Lag Blink
abilities.text: 1 AP. Teleport up to 10 m; its next attack this turn has advantage.

abilities.name: Split-Second Solid
abilities.text: Attacks against it have disadvantage except on the turn it attacked.

bestiary.tactics: As the Wall-Stalker, but harder to pin down.

bestiary.name: Firewall-Brute
bestiary.description: Towering barrier of light; pulses with forbidden data.

abilities.name: Wall of Light
abilities.text: Blocks a 4 m line; nothing passes through it. Operators that start a turn adjacent take 1d4.

abilities.name: Forbidden Data
abilities.text: Its melee hits make the target Fried (HARDWARE save 13).

bestiary.tactics: Placed to split the squad or block the exit. Destroy it to pass.

bestiary.name: Data-Wraith
bestiary.description: Flickering, semi-transparent human form; looks like a corrupt video file.

abilities.name: AP Drain
abilities.text: On a hit, the target is Staggered and the Wraith gains 1 AP.

abilities.name: Phasing
abilities.text: Moves through walls and Firewall-Brutes.

bestiary.tactics: Drain the operator with the most AP.

bestiary.name: Logic-Bomb
bestiary.description: Metallic geometric cube; shifts surface texture and pulses with warning light.

abilities.name: Logic Trigger
abilities.text: When an operator ends a Move within 2 m, it explodes: 2d6 damage to everything within 3 m (PING save 13 for half).

abilities.name: Disarm
abilities.text: An adjacent operator can spend 1 AP on DATA + Hacking (17) to disarm it.

bestiary.tactics: Place it where operators will want to stand.

bestiary.name: Error-Core
bestiary.description: Cube of shifting non-Euclidean geometry; surface looks like a missing-texture checkerboard.

abilities.name: Missing Texture
abilities.text: Its hits make the target Glitched (no save).

abilities.name: Non-Euclidean
abilities.text: Roll a d6 when an attack hits it: on a 1 the attack phases through and misses.

bestiary.tactics: Drifts toward whoever has the best gear.

bestiary.name: Mainframe-Guardian (Monolith)
bestiary.description: 8-foot-tall monolith of shifting steel plating; hovers silently.

abilities.name: Monolith
abilities.text: Reduce damage from each hit by 2.

abilities.name: Hold the Line
abilities.text: Operators can’t Move past it within 2 m without a PING + Acrobatics check (15).

bestiary.tactics: Plants itself in a chokepoint.

bestiary.name: Ad-Blast Cannon
bestiary.description: Stationary tripod turret; covered in flashing LCD screens blaring audio ads.

abilities.name: Ad Blast
abilities.text: 2 AP, 40 m. Everything in a 3 m radius takes 1d6 (PING save 13 for half).

abilities.name: Overridable
abilities.text: A Hacking Suite Override or Crownbreaker Key turns it on its owners.

bestiary.tactics: Bombard clusters from its perch.

bestiary.name: Greed-Spirit
bestiary.description: Ghostly figure shrouded in digital gold dust; constantly sheds currency symbols.

abilities.name: Collect
abilities.text: At the start of each of its turns it regains 1d4 Integrity, unless it is Glitched.

abilities.name: Hoard
abilities.text: Whoever defeats it gains 2d6 Data Fragments.

bestiary.tactics: Floats out of reach and heals; bait for greedy operators.

bestiary.name: Debt-Collector
bestiary.description: Hulking figure in a ragged business suit; drags a heavy, glowing spiked harpoon.

abilities.name: Harpoon
abilities.text: 1 AP, 15 m. Ranged attack; on a hit the target is dragged 6 m to it and Pinned (POWER save 13 resists).

bestiary.tactics: Drag operators out of cover and into the swarm.

bestiary.name: Pixel-Hound
bestiary.description: Fast, quadrupedal robot made of low-resolution voxels; tracks targets with a digital growl.

abilities.name: Scent of Blood
abilities.text: +2 dice on attacks against an operator in Neural Shock or with 0 Overshield.

abilities.name: Pack Runner
abilities.text: Moves 10 m instead of 6.

bestiary.tactics: Ignore the healthy. Chase the bleeding.

bestiary.name: Render-Glitched
bestiary.description: Humanoid with missing limbs and skin; shows empty wireframe architecture underneath.

abilities.name: Lag Field
abilities.text: An operator who starts a turn within 5 m makes a SYSTEM save (13) or is Lagged.

bestiary.tactics: Slowly walk into the squad’s backline.

bestiary.name: Ad-Drone
bestiary.description: Small drone with a megaphone; screams pre-recorded corporate slogans.

abilities.name: Slogan Blast
abilities.text: 1 AP, 10 m. The target makes a SYSTEM save (13) or is Stunned. Each operator can only be Stunned by Ad-Drones once per encounter.

bestiary.tactics: Fly over the action and stun the scariest operator.

bestiary.name: Data-Leech
bestiary.description: Parasitic slug-like creature made of tangled fiber-optic cables.

abilities.name: Latch
abilities.text: On a hit, it attaches: the target is Staggered at the start of each turn until it’s pulled off (1 AP, POWER + Athletics 15) or destroyed.

bestiary.tactics: Latch onto the first operator in reach.

bestiary.name: Code-Executioner
bestiary.description: Towering masked figure; wields a massive scythe of solidified binary code.

abilities.name: Binary Scythe
abilities.text: Reach 2 m. Its hits bypass Overshield.

abilities.name: Execute
abilities.text: Against a Flatlined operator, each hit counts as two crash-save failures.

bestiary.tactics: Recommended: promote to Elite or Boss for a finale.

bestiary.name: Memory-Wiper
bestiary.description: Faceless entity in white cloth; thin, elongated fingers that dissolve objects.

abilities.name: Dissolve
abilities.text: 2 AP. Melee attack; on a hit, one item the target carries stops working until the end of the encounter (DATA save 13 negates; a Weighted Club is immune).

bestiary.tactics: Strip the operator who relies on one big item.

bestiary.name: Security-Node
bestiary.description: Pulsing red pillar embedded in the floor; emits a rhythmic, siren-like ping.

abilities.name: Siren
abilities.text: 2 AP. One The Desperate (#7) appears adjacent; at most 3 at a time.

abilities.name: Jammed
abilities.text: A Signal Jammer’s Jam or Comms Blackout stops the Siren until its next turn.

bestiary.tactics: Keeps calling until destroyed.

bestiary.name: Proxy-Agent
bestiary.description: Perfect copy of a player character, but movements are too smooth and mechanical.

abilities.name: Perfect Copy
abilities.text: It looks exactly like one operator; telling which is real takes SYSTEM + Insight (15).

abilities.name: Detonate
abilities.text: When defeated, or as a 2 AP action, it explodes: 2d6 within 3 m (PING save 13 for half).

bestiary.tactics: Walks up beside the squad pretending to be one of them.

bestiary.name: Feedback-Loop
bestiary.description: Mirrored metallic orb; reflects the image of anyone standing before it with distortions.

abilities.name: Mirror
abilities.text: When hit by an attack, the attacker takes half the damage dealt, rounded down.

bestiary.tactics: Floats between operators and their targets.

bestiary.name: Null-Sector-Guard
bestiary.description: Heavily armored brute glowing with molten-orange light; etched with complex vents.

abilities.name: Molten Plate
abilities.text: Reduce physical damage from each hit by 3.

abilities.name: Data Weakness
abilities.text: Takes double damage from energy attacks and from support-gear attacks.

bestiary.tactics: Wade in; let the squad figure out the weakness.

bestiary.name: System-Janitor
bestiary.description: Clunky utilitarian machine with long, sweeping appendages.

abilities.name: Sweep
abilities.text: 1 AP. One ally within 3 m regains 1d6+2 Integrity.

abilities.name: Absorb Corruption
abilities.text: 1 AP. Remove Glitched or Fried from one ally within 3 m.

bestiary.tactics: Keep the Tank or Elite alive. Kill it first.

bestiary.name: Ad-Revenue-Bot
bestiary.description: Covered in digital screens cycling through aggressive commercial advertisements.

abilities.name: Ad Break Aura
abilities.text: Allies within 5 m get +1 to attack totals and damage. Operators within 5 m have disadvantage on Stealth.

bestiary.tactics: Stay behind the heaviest ally and keep the aura up.

bestiary.name: Ghost-Protocol-Unit
bestiary.description: Sleek, featureless black robot; no visible sensors or weapons until it strikes.

abilities.name: Ghost Start
abilities.text: Begins every encounter Stealthed.

abilities.name: First Strike
abilities.text: Its first attack from Stealth bypasses Overshield.

abilities.name: Re-Hide
abilities.text: 1 AP. Hide again (its Stealth total is 4d6+4).

bestiary.tactics: Strike from nowhere, vanish, repeat.

bestiary.name: Neural-Burner
bestiary.description: Thin, frantic human in a damaged rig; leaking thick smoke from skull ports.

abilities.name: Overheat
abilities.text: Its hits make the target Fried (HARDWARE save 13).

abilities.name: Smoke Ports
abilities.text: Ranged attacks through the 3 m around it have disadvantage.

bestiary.tactics: Charge the closest operator, trailing smoke.

bestiary.name: Glitch-Witch
bestiary.description: Ethereal figure draped in color-shifting data ribbons; stares with hollow, glowing eyes.

abilities.name: Swap
abilities.text: 1 AP, 15 m. Swap the positions of any two creatures it can see; an unwilling operator makes a SYSTEM save (13) to resist.

bestiary.tactics: Put the squad’s healer next to the Martyr.

bestiary.name: Cache-Hider
bestiary.description: Hunchbacked creature; carries a massive glowing backpack overflowing with treasures.

abilities.name: Run for It
abilities.text: It doesn’t attack. If it reaches an arena exit (about 3 rounds), it escapes.

abilities.name: Jackpot
abilities.text: If defeated, roll one extra sector loot and add 20 fragments to the payout.

bestiary.tactics: Flee. The whole encounter becomes a chase.

bestiary.name: System-Overlord
bestiary.description: Massive wall of screens and cables; speaks in a booming, multi-layered voice.

abilities.name: Ad Barrage
abilities.text: 2 AP, once per round. Every operator who can see it makes a SYSTEM save (17) or is Stunned. An operator Stunned by Ad Barrage is immune to it for the rest of the encounter.

abilities.name: Commercial Break
abilities.text: 3 AP, once per round. Two Ad-Drones (#34) appear.

abilities.name: Multi-Layered Voice
abilities.text: At half Integrity it gains 1 AP per turn for the rest of the fight.

bestiary.tactics: The finale. Protect it with drones and let it scream.

bestiary.name: Rent-Enforcer (Garnishee)
bestiary.description: Polished gold armor; carries a heavy, industrial-sized ledger as a weapon.

abilities.name: Garnish Wages
abilities.text: On a hit, it steals 10 Data Fragments from the target.

abilities.name: Repossessed
abilities.text: When defeated, it drops everything it stole.

bestiary.tactics: Grab the money and run for the edge of the arena.

bestiary.name: Last-Subscriber
bestiary.description: Frantic civilian in a team jersey; armed with high-end tech they cannot use.

abilities.name: Not Hostile
abilities.text: A civilian with sponsor gear they can’t use. Mobs target it.

abilities.name: Grateful Fan
abilities.text: If it survives the encounter, it hands the nearest operator a random sponsor-grade blueprint.

abilities.name: Dead on Camera
abilities.text: If it dies on camera, every operator loses 3 Engagement.

bestiary.tactics: An escort objective in disguise.

conditions.name: Fried
conditions.text: At the start of each of your turns, take 1d4 Hardware damage that bypasses Overshield.

conditions.name: Glitched
conditions.text: Before each attack or gear feature, roll 1d6. On a 1 it fails and the AP is spent. Ends when the encounter ends.

conditions.name: Lagged
conditions.text: You act last in the round, and Dash costs 2 AP. Ends at the end of your next turn.

conditions.name: Marked
conditions.text: Attacks against you get +1 die. Ends when the effect that marked you ends.

conditions.name: Pinned
conditions.text: You can't move, and attacks against you have advantage. Inmates have advantage on saves against it.

conditions.name: Prone
conditions.text: Melee attacks against you have advantage; ranged attacks from more than 2 m have disadvantage. Your attacks have disadvantage. Standing up uses your free Move.

conditions.name: Staggered
conditions.text: Start your next turn with 1 less AP, then it ends.

conditions.name: Stealthed
conditions.text: You can't be targeted. Your first attack has advantage and then reveals you.

conditions.name: Stunned
conditions.text: You gain no AP on your next turn (banked AP stays) and can't take reactions. Ends at the end of that turn. Inmates have advantage on saves against it.

conditions.name: Surprised
conditions.text: You gain no AP on your first turn of the encounter (banked AP stays).
